gloss: to grow fond of; to become attached to

definitions.gloss: to grow fond of; to become attached to; to develop affection for
definitions.explanation: To gradually develop feelings of attachment or fondness toward something or someone through familiarity and use over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}いてきた。
examples.english: I've grown fond of these shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}く。
examples.english: You become attached to a tool as you keep using it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}いてきた。
examples.english: At first I wasn't interested, but as I lived here I grew fond of this town.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧ means attachment or affection. Combined with ⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧ (to well up, to spring forth), it expresses the gradual, natural development of fondness. Can be used for objects, places, people, and activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}く (to grow fond of)
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having affection for)
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have attachment to)
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel attachment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{親|した}しみ→親しみ：19963_shitashimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: to feel familiarity/warmth — more about feeling comfortable with someone
- {愛着|あいちゃく}が{湧|わ}く: to become attached — deeper emotional bond, often with objects or places
